# flatbuffers / 64bit_fuzzer

flatbuffers's own fuzz target `64bit_fuzzer` ([source](source/flatbuffers_64bit_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over flatbuffers (google/flatbuffers at 5761d6e6).

Verify-then-access: every field of a verified RootTable (vectors, 64-bit vectors, strings, nested root) is read and hashed; the hash is discarded, so the property is only that verified buffers are memory-safe to read.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against flatbuffers at commit 5761d6e6 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- After VerifyRootTableBuffer accepts, TEST_NOTNULL(root_table): GetRootTable returns buf+offset and cannot be null, so this is trivially true ([line 102](source/flatbuffers_64bit_fuzzer.cc#L102)): a trap; not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch flatbuffers` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `64bit_fuzzer.plain` | 701,544 | `06a80efea140209fb5c54c0343e5365072770fef7cd5261dbfe078484cdae684` |
| ubsan | `64bit_fuzzer.ubsan` | 705,624 | `b2163c493c61e2d70f2fa439c621fe63db50324203355a09eda81a5919f62504` |
| asan | `64bit_fuzzer.asan` | 1,255,032 | `429e3cd6c7633cbd7222d8c76dd892ca8be7489187417bd6019f1fbdced93969` |
| asan-ubsan | `64bit_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 1,248,392 | `d2955a99dc943cc9df69176fe6a0e1c0f1653ed3f89d0c9afaa2e6fa1562e9b3` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
